title: Expose capability-driven Android catalog
scope: Replace Android's rigid_liquid scene subset and parallel description array with the common catalog and runtime capability results.
acceptance: Every common Gallery scene appears in stable order; supported scenes launch and unsupported scenes show a precise reason.
Adding a newly advertised Vulkan capability requires no Android scene-index or description change.

history.reason: Verified the Android picker derives all scene metadata, availability and reasons from the shared 28-scene catalog
